designationHistory.indexText: Bogue Chitto National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1980, straddles the borders of Louisiana and Mississippi, bisected by the Pearl River.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
